# GitHub Copilot — Repository Instructions

See [.github/instructions/copilot-instructions.md](instructions/copilot-instructions.md)
for the authoritative rules (loaded by both GitHub Copilot on the web and

**TL;DR for reviewers:** this project builds privacy-preserving gaze analytics
for digital signage on Intel CPU/iGPU. Frames are never persisted, no face
recognition, no cloud calls. Only aggregate metrics live in SQLite.
